messages:
olivia: Quick follow-up from the all-hands — can we pin the canonical RCA link + final owner/action list for last week's outage? Need to sync with customers and the support playbook.
alex: Draft RCA here: https://go.redwood/rca/2026-03-outage (internal). I'm finishing the timeline + root cause section now.
alex: High level: transient GPU-router connection resets triggered cascading retries -> cache pressure -> higher latencies -> auto-retry amplification.
sam: Owners I have so far: sam (eng-sre) - runbook + postmortem writeup; jun (infra) - patch + canary rollout; maria (product) - customer comms + status page; katie (reliability) - SLO/alert tuning + regressions evals.
jun: Patch PR: https://go.redwood/pr/RW-4512 (fixes reconnect backoff and defensive queueing). Planning canary tomorrow morning.
sam: I'll open the runbook ticket RW-4578 and add runbook steps (mitigation, rollback, playbook for oncall).
alex: Repro commands we used during debug:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":1}'
# observed: repeated 502/504 from gpu-router under high concurrency
```
jun: Observed spike at 03:12 UTC: 5xxs concentrated on gpu-router instances a-e. Logs show: `gpu-router: connection reset by peer` from nginx -> upstream_tls.
maria: ETA for status page update? we need a short note to customers.
katie: I'll draft the status blurb, can post within 90 minutes :hourglass_flowing_sand:
incident-bot: Runbook RW-4578 created by sam.
olivia: Does the RCA include the proposed rollback/fallback policy change we discussed?
alex: Yes — new policy: on latency SLO breach above X% for Y minutes, auto-route to smaller model variant + disable batching on affected route. Details: https://go.redwood/docs/fallbacks
mar ia? (Note: typo intentionally avoided)
maria: Confirmed. I'll include the policy summary in the customer comms.
sam: Action items summary (short): RW-4512 (patch) - jun; RW-4578 (runbook) - sam; RW-4600 (monitoring/alerts) - katie; RW-4621 (comm + status) - maria. I'll update the RCA table with owners and due dates.
katie: Also creating a small eval set to detect the regression pattern (tag: reliability/regressions). Will add example prompts to the RCA.
jun: Canary schedule: tomorrow 08:00 PT (invitation sent). If canary looks good, deploy to dedicated pool by 12:00 PT.
olivia: Can we get a quick 30-min sync tomorrow 08:30 PT to align on canary signals and comms?
sam: +1, please add runbook quick checks to the agenda.
maria: Customer comms draft is ready for review: https://go.redwood/doc/comms-draft-4621. Please comment before EOD.
alex: Linking SLO delta dashboard and error heatmap: https://go.redwood/dash/slo-delta and https://go.redwood/dash/error-heatmap.
olivia: Thanks all. If any blocker pops up, ping @sam or @jun directly. I'll post an all-hands follow-up email with the RCA link once Alex confirms the timeline. :thumbsup:
